avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce promethazine levels; additive photosensitivity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal products

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk; both agents cause drowsiness and impair cognition
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; counsel patient to discontinue kava kava

avoid_supplements.name: Anticholinergic supplements (Jimsonweed, Datura)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Promethazine has anticholinergic properties; additive effects increase risk of urinary retention, severe constipation, altered mental status, and hyperthermia
avoid_supplements.action: Strictly avoid; educate patient on herbal products with anticholinergic activity

caution_supplements.name: Valerian root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression may increase sedation and drowsiness
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive sedation; advise patient to use caution with activities requiring alertness

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.action: Counsel on increased sedation risk; monitor clinical response

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly increase promethazine levels
caution_supplements.action: Limit grapefruit consumption; monitor for increased anticholinergic or sedative effects

avoid_foods.name: Alcohol
avoid_foods.mechanism: Significant additive CNS depression; alcohol impairs metabolism and increases promethazine levels
avoid_foods.action: Advise complete avoidance or strict limitation; warn against driving/operating machinery

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay absorption and alter peak levels of promethazine
caution_foods.action: Administer promethazine consistently with or without food for predictable response

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (cured meats, aged cheeses, fermented products)
caution_foods.mechanism: Phenothiazines may potentiate hypertensive response to tyramine
caution_foods.action: Encourage moderation in high-tyramine food intake; monitor blood pressure

monitoring_notes: Monitor for excessive CNS depression, anticholinergic toxicity (urinary retention, constipation, confusion), and orthostatic hypotension, particularly in elderly patients or those with concurrent medications. Assess compliance with interaction avoidance at each visit and reinforce counseling on alcohol and herbal products with CNS or anticholinergic effects.
